title: Second Course of Mace Fundamentals
summary: Builds on the basic mace drills with qi-driven swings and guards for students who already hold a first manual.

title: Treatise on Foot and Mounted Mace Work
summary: Compares how the mace is swung on foot and from the saddle, with qi lent to each stroke.

title: Breaking Shield and Guard
summary: Teaches how to batter apart shield rims, shield faces and the guards behind them with repeated qi-backed blows.

title: Handbook of the Flanged Head
summary: A handbook of the many ways a flanged head cuts, bites and hooks, with qi sharpening every edge.

title: Rhythm and Weight in Mace Fighting
summary: Teaches the beat of a heavy-headed fight, the pause after each swing, and the weight that returns the head.

title: Practical Mace Against Armor
summary: Sets out the targets, angles and qi-driven strikes that defeat mail, brigandine and plate with a mace.

title: Close-Press Mace Work
summary: Shows how to fight inside a long weapon's reach, using the mace's short grip, pommel and knob.

title: Qi Through the Haft
summary: Teaches how to run qi down the whole haft so every part of the mace carries a measured charge.

title: Footing and Reach for the Mace
summary: Teaches the footing and reach changes that let a mace hold its distance against longer and shorter weapons.

title: Intermediate Mace Workbook
summary: A workbook of graded drills that link every earlier mace skill into longer chains of qi-driven strikes.
